objective: Conditional finite-mass angular pushforward with branch-resolved inverse and explicit identical-daughter normalization; reuse native12 saved events.

conventions.mu: CM polar cosine relative to incident photon
conventions.azimuth: unchanged at regular directions; no imposed azimuthal distribution

equations.inverse: G=gamma^2*(1-nu^2), L=G+nu^2, B=L-a^2*G; roots=(-aG +/- abs(nu)*sqrt(B))/L plus original-sign/domain filter

implementation_domain.mass_adapter: 0<A<2M, e>=threshold; above-threshold map must lie in explicit generic domain
implementation_domain.precision: Exact Fraction admission for binary64 mass/energy inputs; Decimal80 intermediate forward and inverse; binary64 outputs. Not interval-certified; unresolved output raises AngularResolutionError.
implementation_domain.critical_points: Exact rational threshold is an atom; exact stopped daughter has no direction; computed binary64 fold coordinates are declared boundary sentinels, not assertions that stored mu equals the exact real fold. No finite fake caustic density.
implementation_domain.representability: Intermediate/output W,gamma,kappa,threshold,transition,density must be representable; additional explicit rejection may occur inside the mathematical domain.

source_inputs.DCS_and_ERR_S: preserve literal values; no physical-rate interpretation, no factor1/2 without convention
source_inputs.native_J_use: conditional coordinate weights only; no source DCS normalization binding

normalization.EVENT_REPRESENTATIVE_HEMISPHERE: H=h on a single representative domain; integral H=sigma_event
normalization.pair_vs_single: pair observable integrated with inclusive h needs1/2; single-daughter inclusive observable does not
